items.title: 필수 요구사항
items.rule: Replace with one concrete required deliverable from the pinned assignment spec.
items.pass_rule: Replace with one concrete required deliverable from the pinned assignment spec.
items.fail_rule: Required deliverable is missing or materially incomplete.
items.source_requirement: Replace with the exact assignment section and explicit required deliverable.

obligations.rule: Replace with one concrete required deliverable from the pinned assignment spec.

atoms.question: Is the concrete deliverable specified by this item present and materially complete? Judge only the pinned requirement.
atoms.remedy: 명세에 적힌 해당 필수 제출물을 완성하고 근거를 남기세요.

items.title: 주요 결과와 구현의 일치
items.rule: Reported core results and computations agree with submitted implementation and records.
items.pass_rule: Reported core results and computations agree with submitted implementation and records.
items.fail_rule: A contradiction materially changes the result or reproducibility.

obligations.rule: Reported core results and computations agree with submitted implementation and records.

atoms.question: Do central report claims agree with the submitted implementation and records, allowing documented corrections? Local errors alone do not negate the central conclusion.
Are specific factual claims consistent with corresponding records and scope? For a contradiction cite the actual claim and counterexample verbatim.
atoms.remedy: 실제 주장과 대응 근거를 대조하여 사실 오류를 정정하세요.

items.title: 과제 의도와 해석
items.rule: The central analysis addresses the assignment question and stays within observed evidence.
items.pass_rule: The central analysis addresses the assignment question and stays within observed evidence.
items.fail_rule: The central conclusion depends on unsupported claims or misses the required question.

obligations.rule: The central analysis addresses the assignment question and stays within observed evidence.

atoms.question: Does the central analysis answer the pinned assignment question within the scope of the observed evidence?
atoms.remedy: 과제 질문에 대해 관측 근거와 한계를 연결하여 해석하세요.
